title: intmarkserv.com
description: We are in possession of internal documents from Integrated Marketing Services, Inc. ("IMS," Liverpool, NY) covering the period from 2000 to 2026. The total volume exceeds 205 GB: financial statements, payroll records, contracts, bank statements, insurance policies, federal contract documents, corporate correspondence — and, most critically, personal data on hundreds of thousands of individuals who never authorized a direct mail house to store information about their health, finances, or personal lives.
